caption:
Losing distance because your hips won't turn? 🏌️‍♂️

The half-kneeling hip turn trains your lead hip to rotate under control — the move that lets you clear through impact without your low back taking over.

✅ 2 sets x 8 each side
✅ Keep the back knee planted
✅ Rotate from the hip, not the ribs
